items.prompt:
Human activity is connected to the geosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere, and
A) atmosphere
B) sun
C) moon
D) galaxy

steps: Human activity connects to these four systems.

items.prompt:
Burning fossil fuels adds ____ to the atmosphere.
A) carbon dioxide
B) pure oxygen
C) gold
D) salt

steps: Burning fossil fuels adds carbon dioxide.

items.prompt:
A warmer climate can ____ ice in the hydrosphere.
A) melt
B) create
C) freeze more
D) ignore

Clearing a forest affects the biosphere by
A) removing habitat for living things
B) adding habitat
C) cooling the Sun
D) creating new species
items.answer: A) removing habitat for living things

items.prompt:
Polluting a river harms living things, affecting the
A) biosphere
B) sun
C) moon
D) galaxy

A human activity in one Earth system can affect the others because
A) the systems are connected and interact
B) the systems are separate
C) nothing is connected
D) only one system exists
items.answer: A) the systems are connected and interact

items.prompt:
Which best models how burning fossil fuels ripples through Earth's systems?
A) Geosphere fuels to atmosphere carbon dioxide to warming to melting hydrosphere ice and biosphere stress
B) It only affects the air
C) It affects nothing
D) It only affects rocks
items.answer: A) Geosphere fuels to atmosphere carbon dioxide to warming to melting hydrosphere ice and biosphere stress

steps: The activity spreads across the systems.

items.prompt:
Clearing a forest can increase atmospheric carbon dioxide because
A) fewer trees take in carbon dioxide, so more stays in the air
B) trees add carbon dioxide
C) forests have no effect on air
D) it cools the planet
items.answer: A) fewer trees take in carbon dioxide, so more stays in the air

steps: Lost trees leave more carbon dioxide in the air.
